Discover the power of our app - Device Monitor Z (also known as iDevice Monitor) is an app optimized for iPhone, iPod Touch, and iPad users. It provides a quick and efficient way to access activity monitor (CPU monitor, detailed RAM, Storage space, ...) and system information of device.

- Key Features:

• View basic CPU information and real-time CPU monitor
• View basic device information (System status)
• View basic OS (Operating System) information
• View basic battery information
• Check Memory & Disk (RAM & Storage) information details.
• Monitor network traffic with real-time upload and download speeds.
• Possible to clean RAM memory with a simple Free up RAM memory button.
• Support Quick Actions to run functions quickly from Home Screen
• Access camera information.
• Access display information.
• Check supported sensors

- Support Widget to display device information such as RAM/Disk/CPU/Battery/Network info:
• iOS 14 Home Widget
• iOS 16 Lock Widget
• iOS 17 Standby Mode for Widget
